explanation: Brute-force attack detected: 5 failed login attempts from IP 192.168.1.100 for user 'admin' followed by a successful login. This indicates a password was guessed.
Account persistence detected: User 'backdoor' was created and then immediately added to the 'sudo' group. This is a common attacker pattern for establishing persistent privileged access.

USB execution detected: An unknown USB device (0781:5581) was plugged in, mounted at '/media/usb0', and then a process was started from that path ('/media/usb0/payload.sh'). This may indicate USB-based malware delivery.
Web-to-shell detected: Web server process 'nginx' (PID 1234) spawned a shell/interpreter 'bash'. This typically indicates a web shell or remote code execution exploit.
Download-to-run detected: File '/home/user/Downloads/miner.elf' appeared in Downloads and was subsequently executed. This may indicate a drive-by download or phishing payload.
Log tampering detected near other suspicious activity: /var/log/auth.log was truncated. This may indicate an attacker covering their tracks.
